d:
In this enriching and contemplative episode of The Slow Interview with Neelesh Misra, we are honoured to host Yatindra Mishra—renowned Hindi poet, biographer, music and cinema scholar, and a prince of Ayodhya’s royal family. This intimate and deeply insightful conversation explores the intersections of heritage, art, Indian classical music, memory, and the enduring power of storytelling.
Yatindra Mishra has authored four acclaimed poetry collections—Yada-Kada, Ayodhya Tatha Anya Kavitayein, Dyorhi Par Aalaap, and Vibhas—but his legacy extends far beyond poetry.
